# fusescope_rule (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Rules reference channels by display name, so create them first and let the
# reference order the apply.
resource "fusescope_notification_channel" "primary" {
  name         = "webhook-primary"
  display_name = "webhook-primary"

  config = {
    webhook = {
      kind = "webhook"
      spec = {
        url           = "https://example.com/webhook-primary"
        send_resolved = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "fusescope_notification_channel" "escalation" {
  name         = "webhook-escalation"
  display_name = "webhook-escalation"

  config = {
    webhook = {
      kind = "webhook"
      spec = {
        url           = "https://example.com/webhook-escalation"
        send_resolved = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "fusescope_rule" "pod_cpu" {
  alert      = "Pod CPU above 80% of request"
  alert_type = "METRIC_BASED_ALERT"
  rule_type  = "threshold_rule"

  annotations = {
    description = "Pod {{$k8s.pod.name}} CPU is at {{$value}} of request in {{$deployment.environment}}."
    summary     = "Pod CPU above {{$threshold}} of request"
  }

  condition = {
    composite_query = {
      panel_type = "graph"
      query_type = "builder"
      unit       = "percentunit"

      queries = [
        {
          builder_query = {
            type = "builder_query"
            spec = {
              metrics = {
                name   = "A"
                signal = "metrics"

                aggregations = [
                  {
                    metric_name       = "k8s.pod.cpu_request_utilization"
                    space_aggregation = "max"
                    time_aggregation  = "avg"
                  }
                ]

                filter = {
                  expression = "k8s.deployment.name = 'api-service'"
                }

                group_by = [
                  {
                    field_context   = "resource"
                    field_data_type = "string"
                    name            = "k8s.pod.name"
                  },
                  {
                    field_context   = "resource"
                    field_data_type = "string"
                    name            = "deployment.environment"
                  }
                ]

                legend        = "{{k8s.pod.name}} ({{deployment.environment}})"
                step_interval = "60"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }

    selected_query_name = "A"

    thresholds = {
      basic = {
        kind = "basic"
        spec = [
          {
            channels = [
              fusescope_notification_channel.primary.display_name,
              fusescope_notification_channel.escalation.display_name,
            ]
            match_type = "all_the_times"
            name       = "critical"
            op         = "above"
            target     = 0.8
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  description = "CPU usage for api-service pods exceeds 80% of the requested CPU"

  evaluation = {
    rolling = {
      kind = "rolling"
      spec = {
        eval_window = "15m"
        frequency   = "1m"
      }
    }
  }

  labels = {
    severity = "critical"
    team     = "platform"
  }

  notification_settings = {
    group_by = ["k8s.pod.name", "deployment.environment"]
    renotify = {
      alert_states = ["firing"]
      enabled      = true
      interval     = "4h"
    }
  }

  schema_version = "v2alpha1"
}
```

```terraform
# Exceptions-based rules query the exceptions table with ClickHouse SQL. The
# query must return `value` and `interval` columns; other columns become labels.
resource "fusescope_notification_channel" "exceptions" {
  name         = "webhook-exceptions"
  display_name = "webhook-exceptions"

  config = {
    webhook = {
      kind = "webhook"
      spec = {
        url           = "https://example.com/webhook-exceptions"
        send_resolved = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "fusescope_rule" "exceptions" {
  alert      = "Exceptions per service"
  alert_type = "EXCEPTIONS_BASED_ALERT"
  rule_type  = "threshold_rule"

  annotations = {
    summary     = "{{$serviceName}} raised {{$value}} {{$exceptionType}} exceptions"
    description = "{{$serviceName}} raised {{$value}} {{$exceptionType}} exceptions in the last 5 minutes (threshold {{$threshold}})."
  }

  condition = {
    composite_query = {
      panel_type = "graph"
      query_type = "clickhouse_sql"

      queries = [
        {
          clickhouse_sql = {
            type = "clickhouse_sql"
            spec = {
              name  = "A"
              query = <<-EOT
                SELECT
                  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, toIntervalMinute(1)) AS interval,
                  serviceName,
                  exceptionType,
                  toFloat64(count()) AS value
                FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_error_index_v2
                WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}}
                GROUP BY serviceName, exceptionType, interval
              EOT
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }

    selected_query_name = "A"

    thresholds = {
      basic = {
        kind = "basic"
        spec = [
          {
            name       = "warning"
            op         = "above"
            match_type = "in_total"
            target     = 10
            channels   = [fusescope_notification_channel.exceptions.display_name]
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  evaluation = {
    rolling = {
      kind = "rolling"
      spec = {
        eval_window = "5m"
        frequency   = "1m"
      }
    }
  }

  notification_settings = {
    group_by = ["serviceName", "exceptionType"]
  }

  schema_version = "v2alpha1"
}
```

```terraform
resource "fusescope_rule" "error_logs" {
  alert      = "Error logs per service"
  alert_type = "LOGS_BASED_ALERT"
  rule_type  = "threshold_rule"

  annotations = {
    summary     = "{{$service.name}} logged {{$value}} errors in 5m"
    description = "{{$service.name}} in {{$deployment.environment}} logged {{$value}} ERROR/FATAL lines in the last 5 minutes (threshold {{$threshold}})."
  }

  condition = {
    composite_query = {
      panel_type = "graph"
      query_type = "builder"

      queries = [
        {
          builder_query = {
            type = "builder_query"
            spec = {
              logs = {
                name   = "A"
                signal = "logs"

                aggregations = [
                  { expression = "count()" }
                ]

                filter = {
                  expression = "severity_text IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL')"
                }

                group_by = [
                  {
                    name          = "service.name"
                    field_context = "resource"
                  },
                  {
                    name          = "deployment.environment"
                    field_context = "resource"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }

    selected_query_name = "A"

    thresholds = {
      basic = {
        kind = "basic"
        spec = [
          {
            name       = "warning"
            op         = "above"
            match_type = "in_total"
            target     = 50
            channels   = [fusescope_notification_channel.logs.display_name]
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  evaluation = {
    rolling = {
      kind = "rolling"
      spec = {
        eval_window = "5m"
        frequency   = "1m"
      }
    }
  }

  notification_settings = {
    group_by = ["service.name", "deployment.environment"]
  }

  schema_version = "v2alpha1"
}
```

```terraform
# Dotted OpenTelemetry names are quoted in PromQL: {"metric.name", "attr.name"="..."}.
resource "fusescope_notification_channel" "infra" {
  name         = "webhook-infra"
  display_name = "webhook-infra"

  config = {
    webhook = {
      kind = "webhook"
      spec = {
        url           = "https://example.com/webhook-infra"
        send_resolved = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "fusescope_rule" "host_memory" {
  alert      = "Host memory above 90%"
  alert_type = "METRIC_BASED_ALERT"
  rule_type  = "promql_rule"

  annotations = {
    summary     = "{{$host.name}} memory usage is {{$value}}"
    description = "Memory used on {{$host.name}} has stayed above {{$threshold}} for 10 minutes."
  }

  condition = {
    composite_query = {
      panel_type = "graph"
      query_type = "promql"
      unit       = "percentunit"

      queries = [
        {
          promql = {
            type = "promql"
            spec = {
              name  = "A"
              query = "max by (\"host.name\") ({\"system.memory.utilization\", state=\"used\"})"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }

    selected_query_name = "A"

    thresholds = {
      basic = {
        kind = "basic"
        spec = [
          {
            name       = "critical"
            op         = "above"
            match_type = "all_the_times"
            target     = 0.9
            channels   = [fusescope_notification_channel.infra.display_name]
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  evaluation = {
    rolling = {
      kind = "rolling"
      spec = {
        eval_window = "10m"
        frequency   = "1m"
      }
    }
  }

  labels = {
    team = "infra"
  }

  notification_settings = {
    group_by = ["host.name"]
  }

  schema_version = "v2alpha1"
}
```

```terraform
# Annotations are Go templates: {{$value}} and {{$threshold}} are the observed
# value and the target, {{$<label>}} (e.g. {{$service.name}}) reads an alert label.
resource "fusescope_notification_channel" "traffic" {
  name         = "webhook-traffic"
  display_name = "webhook-traffic"

  config = {
    webhook = {
      kind = "webhook"
      spec = {
        url           = "https://example.com/webhook-traffic"
        send_resolved = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "fusescope_rule" "traffic_drop" {
  alert       = "Request rate dropped"
  alert_type  = "TRACES_BASED_ALERT"
  rule_type   = "threshold_rule"
  description = "Server request rate per service fell below the expected floor."

  annotations = {
    summary     = "{{$service.name}} receives {{$value}} req/s (floor {{$threshold}})"
    description = <<-EOT
      Request rate of {{$service.name}} in {{$deployment.environment}} is {{$value}} req/s,
      below the floor of {{$threshold}} req/s. Check the load balancer and recent deploys.
    EOT
    runbook_url = "https://runbooks.example.com/traffic-drop"
  }

  labels = {
    team = "checkout"
  }

  condition = {
    alert_on_absent = true
    absent_for      = 15

    composite_query = {
      panel_type = "graph"
      query_type = "builder"
      unit       = "reqps"

      queries = [
        {
          builder_query = {
            type = "builder_query"
            spec = {
              traces = {
                name   = "A"
                signal = "traces"

                aggregations = [
                  { expression = "rate()" }
                ]

                filter = {
                  expression = "kind_string = 'Server' AND service.name = 'checkout'"
                }

                group_by = [
                  {
                    name          = "service.name"
                    field_context = "resource"
                  },
                  {
                    name          = "deployment.environment"
                    field_context = "resource"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }

    selected_query_name = "A"

    thresholds = {
      basic = {
        kind = "basic"
        spec = [
          {
            name       = "warning"
            op         = "below"
            match_type = "all_the_times"
            target     = 1
            channels   = [fusescope_notification_channel.traffic.display_name]
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  evaluation = {
    rolling = {
      kind = "rolling"
      spec = {
        eval_window = "15m"
        frequency   = "5m"
      }
    }
  }

  notification_settings = {
    group_by             = ["service.name", "deployment.environment"]
    new_group_eval_delay = "10m"
    renotify = {
      enabled      = true
      interval     = "1h"
      alert_states = ["firing", "nodata"]
    }
  }

  schema_version = "v2alpha1"
}
```

```terraform
resource "fusescope_notification_channel" "errors" {
  name         = "webhook-errors"
  display_name = "webhook-errors"

  config = {
    webhook = {
      kind = "webhook"
      spec = {
        url           = "https://example.com/webhook-errors"
        send_resolved = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "fusescope_rule" "error_rate" {
  alert      = "Error rate per service"
  alert_type = "TRACES_BASED_ALERT"
  rule_type  = "threshold_rule"

  annotations = {
    summary     = "{{$service.name}} error rate is {{$value}}%"
    description = "{{$value}}% of {{$service.name}} server spans failed (threshold {{$threshold}}%)."
  }

  condition = {
    composite_query = {
      panel_type = "graph"
      query_type = "builder"
      unit       = "percent"

      queries = [
        {
          builder_query = {
            type = "builder_query"
            spec = {
              traces = {
                name     = "A"
                signal   = "traces"
                disabled = true

                aggregations = [
                  { expression = "count()" }
                ]

                filter = {
                  expression = "kind_string = 'Server' AND has_error = true"
                }

                group_by = [
                  {
                    name          = "service.name"
                    field_context = "resource"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        {
          builder_query = {
            type = "builder_query"
            spec = {
              traces = {
                name     = "B"
                signal   = "traces"
                disabled = true

                aggregations = [
                  { expression = "count()" }
                ]

                filter = {
                  expression = "kind_string = 'Server'"
                }

                group_by = [
                  {
                    name          = "service.name"
                    field_context = "resource"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        {
          builder_formula = {
            type = "builder_formula"
            spec = {
              name       = "F1"
              expression = "A * 100 / B"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }

    selected_query_name = "F1"

    thresholds = {
      basic = {
        kind = "basic"
        spec = [
          {
            name       = "critical"
            op         = "above"
            match_type = "on_average"
            target     = 5
            channels   = [fusescope_notification_channel.errors.display_name]
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  evaluation = {
    rolling = {
      kind = "rolling"
      spec = {
        eval_window = "5m"
        frequency   = "1m"
      }
    }
  }

  notification_settings = {
    group_by = ["service.name"]
  }

  schema_version = "v2alpha1"
}
```

```terraform
# Each threshold notifies its own channels; the threshold name becomes the
# alert's severity label.
resource "fusescope_notification_channel" "team" {
  name         = "webhook-team"
  display_name = "webhook-team"

  config = {
    webhook = {
      kind = "webhook"
      spec = {
        url           = "https://example.com/webhook-team"
        send_resolved = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "fusescope_notification_channel" "oncall" {
  name         = "webhook-oncall"
  display_name = "webhook-oncall"

  config = {
    webhook = {
      kind = "webhook"
      spec = {
        url           = "https://example.com/webhook-oncall"
        send_resolved = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "fusescope_rule" "p99_latency" {
  alert      = "p99 latency per service"
  alert_type = "TRACES_BASED_ALERT"
  rule_type  = "threshold_rule"

  annotations = {
    summary     = "{{$service.name}} p99 latency is {{$value}}"
    description = "p99 latency of {{$service.name}} server spans crossed {{$threshold}}."
  }

  condition = {
    composite_query = {
      panel_type = "graph"
      query_type = "builder"
      unit       = "ns"

      queries = [
        {
          builder_query = {
            type = "builder_query"
            spec = {
              traces = {
                name   = "A"
                signal = "traces"

                aggregations = [
                  { expression = "p99(duration_nano)" }
                ]

                filter = {
                  expression = "kind_string = 'Server' AND deployment.environment = 'production'"
                }

                group_by = [
                  {
                    name          = "service.name"
                    field_context = "resource"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }

    selected_query_name = "A"

    thresholds = {
      basic = {
        kind = "basic"
        spec = [
          {
            name            = "warning"
            op              = "above"
            match_type      = "on_average"
            target          = 500
            target_unit     = "ms"
            recovery_target = 400
            channels        = [fusescope_notification_channel.team.display_name]
          },
          {
            name        = "critical"
            op          = "above"
            match_type  = "on_average"
            target      = 1000
            target_unit = "ms"
            channels = [
              fusescope_notification_channel.team.display_name,
              fusescope_notification_channel.oncall.display_name,
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  evaluation = {
    rolling = {
      kind = "rolling"
      spec = {
        eval_window = "10m"
        frequency   = "1m"
      }
    }
  }

  notification_settings = {
    group_by = ["service.name"]
  }

  schema_version = "v2alpha1"
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Rules are imported using their ID.
terraform import fusescope_rule.pod_cpu 0192a9c2-1234-7abc-8def-0123456789ab
```
